pt-PT.question: O Nobel da Literatura de 1902 foi para o historiador Theodor Mommsen. Que obra a Academia Sueca destacou?
options: Um romance histórico sobre Júlio César
pt-PT.explanation: Uma história de Roma. A Academia Sueca premiou Mommsen como «o maior mestre vivo da arte de escrever história», com referência especial à sua monumental História de Roma, escrita em parte quando era professor em Zurique.

en-US.question: The 1902 Nobel Prize in Literature went to historian Theodor Mommsen. Which work did the Swedish Academy highlight?
options: A historical novel about Julius Caesar
A Latin translation of the Aeneid
en-US.explanation: A history of Rome. The Swedish Academy honored Mommsen as "the greatest living master of the art of historical writing," citing his monumental A History of Rome, written partly while he was a professor in Zurich.

fontes.titulo: Theodor Mommsen – Nobel Prize in Literature 1902 | University of Zurich
fontes.excerto: Mommsen wrote his monumental History of Rome during his time as Professor at the University of Zurich. [...] for which, some 50 years later in 1902, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.
Mommsen's most celebrated work, Römische Geschichte (The History of Rome), ... earning him the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1902.
